sources.used: Official names, three Sinnoh lakes; Uxie knowledge, Mesprit emotion, Azelf willpower.
The Red Chain is linked to the three lake guardians; in Legends Arceus they craft it from their gifts.
Uxie at Lake Acuity, Mesprit at Lake Verity, Azelf at Lake Valor.

creativeAdaptation: Original cinematic, not an asserted canonical cutscene: the lights of three lakes converge at mountain ruins and form a Red Chain, which resonates with each lake before its guardian appears. No official video or music reused.
